known_open: Installation is internal and inactive. Production factory, command/GUI writers, template binding, recovery/status and lifecycle must switch together.
Caller must stop all old writers; source file locks and SQL snapshot reads cannot create atomicity in legacy independent writers.
Source choice is explicit and permanent; administrative resolution of wrong pending selections and portable relocation need separate verified procedures.
No MySQL support or automatic SQL/file fallback; SQL requires a real persistent single main SQLite database.
Lease money still uses ordinary transfer/refund operations without durable business receipts or restart recovery.
Temporary permission ownership/lifecycle policy remains independent.
Cuboid/foundation treaty and siege receivers, legacy restriction reconciliation and permissioned lifting.
Reparation, tribute, loan, navy transport/ports, wounded return, doctrine, budget rollover/cancel and archival.
Full clean Core build, new release artifacts and final Core plus Supply regression.
SQL multiprocess/latest MySQL and user-deferred Paper/Folia acceptance.
